readings: For each film rating, average replacement_cost across films with that rating. For those same films, calculate rental_rate divided by rental_duration for each film, then average those per-film daily prices. Divide each rating’s average daily price by the arithmetic mean of the five rating-level average daily prices, counting each rating once. Leave all numbers unrounded.

For each film rating, average replacement_cost, rental_rate, and rental_duration separately across films with that rating. Calculate the rating’s daily price by dividing its average rental_rate by its average rental_duration. Divide that daily price by the arithmetic mean of the five rating-level daily prices, counting each rating once. Leave all numbers unrounded.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  avg_daily_price,
  avg_daily_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) FROM rating_averages) AS relative_avg_daily_price
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
rating_prices AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    avg_replacement_cost,
    avg_rental_rate,
    avg_rental_duration,
    avg_rental_rate / avg_rental_duration AS daily_price
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  avg_rental_rate,
  avg_rental_duration,
  daily_price,
  daily_price / (SELECT AVG(daily_price) FROM rating_prices) AS relative_daily_price
FROM rating_prices
